Switching is faster, and the switch window is calmer and clearer. Tested on the owner's PC before release.

**What changed**

- **Codex switches take seconds, not a minute.** The switcher used to update each Hermes profile one after another while the gateway was stopped. With many profiles that took about a minute, long enough for Hermes Desktop to start a temporary gateway of its own, so the open chat dropped twice. Profiles are now updated side by side.
- **Errors can be dismissed.** An old switch result no longer sticks around. A past failure becomes a plain "earlier attempt" note once a fresh check passes.
- **"Switch completed" button.** After a switch finishes, the button says so. It goes back to "Switch account" when you pick something else. If the accounts you chose are already in use, the window says that instead of asking you to pick different ones.
- **Calm message while the gateway restarts.** During a switch the gateway is down on purpose. The window now shows a neutral "restarting" note instead of red connection errors, and only turns red if the restart takes more than 3 minutes.
- **The window tells you when Hermes Desktop needs a restart.** Hermes Desktop keeps its own copy of the switch window from when it started. After an update, a switch now says plainly to close and reopen Hermes Desktop, instead of quietly showing the old window.
- **Fewer false alarms.** A Claude login file that is briefly busy is retried instead of being reported as signed out, and every gateway check now reads the gateway's status the same way.
- **Automatic tests.** Every change is now tested automatically on Windows before it is merged.

**After installing:** fully close Hermes Desktop and open it again so it loads the new switch window.

The archive, its SHA-256 and the release gates are attached. Technical details are in `docs/release-notes.md`.
